translations.web: He said to them, “Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!” They went out, and struck in the city.
translations.bsb: Then He told them, “Defile the temple and fill the courts with the slain. Go forth!” So they went out and began killing throughout the city.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.
translations.asv: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and smote in the city.
